# agentic-obsidian

> One-click deployment of headless Obsidian with CLI on remote Linux VMs for AI agents.

## What it does

Deploys Obsidian (the knowledge management app) on a headless Linux VM so that
AI agents can programmatically read, write, search, and manage an Obsidian vault
via CLI commands, an HTTP API, or SSH.

## Why it exists

Obsidian CLI (1.12+ Catalyst beta) requires the Obsidian GUI app to be running.
On headless servers, this requires a virtual framebuffer (Xvfb) and specific
configuration. This project automates the entire setup.

## Two-phase install

1. `install.sh` — Installs the base system: Obsidian 1.11.7 AppImage on Xvfb,
   systemd services, HTTP API, cron jobs. The config is pre-set with
   `insider: true` so the auto-updater will fetch the 1.12+ beta on first boot.

2. `agent-setup.sh` — One-shot post-install: authenticates with an Obsidian
   Catalyst account, waits for the insider .asar to download, stores the account
   token, and creates/connects an Obsidian Sync remote vault.

## Architecture

- Obsidian AppImage extracted to /opt/obsidian/squashfs-root/
- Xvfb provides a virtual display on :99
- Obsidian runs headlessly with --no-sandbox --disable-gpu
- The insider .asar (1.12+) enables the CLI (auto-downloaded on first boot)
- An HTTP API on port 3000 wraps CLI commands as REST endpoints
- Cron jobs handle heartbeat monitoring and vault backups
- systemd manages all services

## Access Methods

1. SSH: `ssh vm 'DISPLAY=:99 obsidian <command>'`
2. HTTP API: `curl https://vm.exe.xyz/read?file=note`
3. Direct CLI (on the VM): `DISPLAY=:99 obsidian help`

## Installation

Generic Linux:
  curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Zpankz/agentic-obsidian/main/install.sh | bash
  ./agent-setup.sh --email you@example.com --password 'pass' --vault-name my-vault

exe.dev:
  ./exe-install.sh <vm-name>

## agent-setup.sh options

  --email <email>           Obsidian account email
  --password <password>     Obsidian account password
  --vault-name <name>       Remote vault name
  --vault-path <path>       Local vault path
  --region <region>         Sync region
  --connect-existing        Connect to existing vault
  --skip-insider            Skip insider upgrade
  --skip-sync               Skip sync setup
  --timeout <seconds>       Max wait for download (default: 60)
  --json                    Output results as JSON

## API Endpoints

- GET /health — service status
- GET /version — Obsidian version
- GET /vault — vault info
- GET /files — list files
- GET /read?file=X — read file content
- GET /search?q=X — search vault
- GET /tags — list tags
- POST /create — create file {name, content}
- POST /append — append to file {file, content}
- POST /daily/append — append to daily note {content}
- POST /command — run arbitrary CLI command {command}

## Key technical details

- Cloudflare blocks api.obsidian.md without browser-like User-Agent/Origin headers
- The insider .asar is signed (RSA-SHA256) and hash-verified (SHA-256) by Obsidian's updater
- The account token singleton is module-scoped; localStorage changes require app restart
- Sync host param must be bare hostname (e.g. sync-49.obsidian.md), not wss:// URL
- The .asar download URL only works through Obsidian's Electron net module, not curl

## Requirements

- Linux x86_64
- Obsidian Catalyst license (for CLI, requires 1.12+ .asar)
- sudo access for apt and systemd
